title: chat.device.registered payload (v1)
description: Emitted when a linked device completes registration on the Chat service. Public device metadata only: identity_key_fingerprint is a client-derived verification string, and raw public key bytes, device labels, and private key material never appear in events of this type. Envelope contract: aggregate_type 'device', aggregate_id 'device_id', aggregate_version 1 (the first version of the device aggregate).

device_id.description: Server-assigned device record ID; soft reference to chat_db.chat_devices.id.

user_id.description: Device owner; soft reference to chat_db.chat_users.id (same ID as social_db.users.id).

identity_key_fingerprint.description: Stable, client-derived verification fingerprint of the device identity key.
